title: Interaction with Dr. S. Jaishankar – External Affairs Minister of India
summary: A distinguished gathering at the Embassy of India, Kuwait, bringing together members of the Indian community for an interaction with India's External Affairs Minister, Dr. S. Jaishankar.
description:
On 8 July 2026, the Embassy of India in Kuwait hosted a special interaction with Dr. S. Jaishankar, India's External Affairs Minister, bringing together representatives from various sections of the Indian community.

The gathering provided a meaningful opportunity for community representatives to engage with India's leadership, reflecting the enduring connection between India and its diaspora in Kuwait.

The occasion highlighted the importance of community participation, dialogue and the continuing relationship between the Indian Embassy and the Indian community.

A memorable and distinguished encounter, representing another meaningful chapter in a journey of community engagement and service.

title: Interaction with the All-Party Indian Parliamentary Delegation – Kuwait
summary: A memorable interaction with distinguished members of the All-Party Indian Parliamentary Delegation visiting Kuwait, reflecting the importance of diplomatic engagement, national unity and the enduring ties between India and Kuwait.
description:
In May 2025, an All-Party Indian Parliamentary Delegation led by Shri Baijayant Jay Panda visited Kuwait as part of India's international diplomatic outreach, conveying the nation's united commitment to combating terrorism and strengthening international cooperation.

The visit brought together distinguished parliamentary leaders, diplomatic representatives and members of the Indian community, providing an opportunity for meaningful engagement and dialogue.

The occasion highlighted the important role of the Indian diaspora in strengthening people-to-people relationships and fostering mutual understanding between India and Kuwait.

A memorable encounter with distinguished representatives of India's parliamentary leadership, reflecting the spirit of national unity, international cooperation and the strong bonds connecting the two nations.

title: An Engaging Encounter with Smt. Smriti Irani – Modialogue Book Launch, Kuwait
summary: A memorable interaction with former Union Minister Smt. Smriti Irani during the unveiling of Modialogue in Kuwait, an occasion bringing together distinguished guests and members of the Indian community to celebrate literature, ideas and meaningful dialogue.
description:
The unveiling of Modialogue, authored by Dr. Ashwin Fernandes, in Kuwait on 22 December 2024 provided a memorable opportunity to meet and interact with Smt. Smriti Irani, former Union Minister of India.

The gathering brought together distinguished guests and members of the Indian community for an occasion celebrating literature, leadership and the exchange of ideas. The book, inspired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Mann Ki Baat programme, offered a perspective on communication, public engagement and national development.

A particularly memorable aspect of the occasion was the opportunity for a personal interaction with Smt. Smriti Irani, reflecting the warmth and accessibility that can make such community encounters especially meaningful.

Beyond the literary significance of the event, the gathering highlighted the importance of dialogue, community connections and opportunities for Indians living abroad to engage with prominent personalities from India.
